# Corsair Charts: governments and names (hand-written; the outfits, ships and
# fleets are generated by tools/gen.py).

# The couriers and the guards of a treasure trail: pirates who keep their own
# counsel. Hostile to the player, indifferent to everyone else, so that killing
# them never rolls for another chart (the trigger only counts stock pirates).
government "Charts Corsair"
	"display name" "Pirate"
	swizzle 6
	color "governments: Pirate"
	"player reputation" -1000
	"bribe" 0
	"fine" 0
	"hostile hail" "hostile pirate"
	"hostile disabled hail" "hostile disabled pirate"

# A rival treasure hunter who has the same chart and wants you dead first.
government "Charts Rival"
	"display name" "Treasure Hunter"
	swizzle 3
	color .85 .55 .2
	"player reputation" -1000
	"bribe" 0
	"fine" 0
	"hostile hail" "hostile pirate"
	"hostile disabled hail" "hostile disabled pirate"

# The caches: derelicts whose owners would not have shared. Hostile to the
# player, so that boarding one plunders it (boarding a ship that is not an
# enemy repairs it instead); a derelict never fights back.
government "Charts Derelict"
	"display name" "Derelict"
	swizzle 0
	color .6 .6 .6
	"player reputation" -1000
	"bribe" 0
	"fine" 0

phrase "charts corsair"
	phrase
		"pirate" 1

phrase "charts courier"
	word
		"Quiet Mercy"
		"Last Ledger"
		"Salt and Silence"
		"The Long Pocket"
		"Whisper Run"
		"Dead Letter"
		"Folded Map"
		"Crow's Errand"
		"Low Tide Courier"
		"Smoke Signal"

phrase "charts wreck"
	word
		"Drifting Hold"
		"Buried Star"
		"Cold Strongroom"
		"Old Gold"
		"Hollow Purse"
		"Graveyard Shift"
		"Widow's Dowry"
		"Sunk Cost"
